selection_note: I selected the 14 CFR parts of members.json from publisher metadata only: the eCFR title list, the eCFR structure API of 2026-11-24 and the cfr_references of the Federal Register API. No part is in bench/regulatory or in a file under bench/, and no Federal Register document that bench/ names amends one of them. Selection never used a document body, a value or a model output. The owner approved the download on 2026-11-27 in #750.
label_method: The method of bench/regulatory: two blind label passes, pass a by Claude Code and pass b by Codex, each with the slots and the named sections only. A second blind check by the other harness on each absence. The owner decides each disagreement with bench/label/decide.py. passes.py seal writes labels.json before any benchmark model output on this set.
source_use: Each member is a US government work and is cited by its point-in-time eCFR versioner URL and SHA-256. The XML and the reader text stay in local work storage; sources.py downloads the same bytes again.

reader_text.code_digest_method: sha256 over sorted src/groundgate/read/*.py lines "name NUL sha256(file) LF"
reader_text.note: Text files stay in local work storage with the XML. Only their hashes are published.
